lines.t: VERSE 1
Child, I’ve walked beside you in the quiet,
I’ve seen your tears fall where no one knew.
I’ve held your heart through every shadow,
And still I whisper, “I am calling you.”
PRE-CHORUS
For I am near—closer than the breath you breathe.
I am the light you feel but cannot see.
CHORUS
Hear My voice, beloved one—
I’m singing hope into your bones.
I’m breaking chains you thought would never
Loose their hold, you’re not alone.
I whisper truth into your soul,
I call you out of night to Me—
Beloved… you are Mine, you are free.
VERSE 2
I’ve walked the roads that left you broken,
I’ve carried wounds that mirror yours.
I’ve carried wounds that mirror yours.
I know the ache you hide in silence,
But in My love, there’s nothing to endure alone.
Come rest in Me—
Let all your striving fade away.
I am the dawn that rises on your day.
CHORUS
Hear My voice, beloved one—
I’m singing hope into your bones.
I’m breaking chains you thought would never
Loose their hold, you’re not alone.
I whisper truth into your soul,
I call you out of night to Me—
Beloved… you are Mine, you are free.
BRIDGE
I’m the still, small voice that stirs your spirit.
I’m the fire warming you inside the storm.
I’m the path beneath your trembling footsteps—
Come closer now… come be reborn.
FINAL CHORUS
Hear My voice, beloved one—
I sing a love that never fades.
I lift your head, I calm your heart,
I lead you through the darkest days.
I whisper life into your shadows,
I call you evermore to Me—
Beloved… you are Mine, you are free.
